## Fixed

- Show named, independently switchable borderless game windows reported as AXWindow/AXUnknown instead of silently rejecting them. Keep visible and minimized windows in the ordinary current-Space and display projection.
- Confirm nonmodal state, a same-process application parent, reasonable geometry and AXMain settable capability before admission. This reads capability without activating or changing the window.
- Preserve transient-popup, empty-title, system-surface, transparency and below-normal-layer exclusions, including the Feishu title fallback.

## Verification

996 XCTest tests pass locally, with another 211 constrained-executor lifecycle tests, 13 Python tests, 24 Node.js tests and 3 WindowLab checks. The arm64 Release build, stripped binary and deployment-availability checks pass. Independent review identified two admission guard gaps; both were reproduced RED, fixed GREEN and checked by controlled mutations.

An invisible native AppKit fixture verifies the borderless AXUnknown case and rejects a non-main popup. Production reader/admission/presentation tests cover seed, scan, launch retry, minimized state, two displays and current-Space membership. The original WoW 1.60.1 journal confirms one successfully read window rejected by the old filter; post-fix live WoW acceptance has not been performed.

The release workflow reruns tests, constrained-executor checks, WindowLab replay, deployment checks and installable-package verification before publication.
